description: Captain-General (Trajann, aura) re-rolls hit 1s — and the player can SEE it. Fixture cus11e_c7_shoot: the Custodian Guard (within 6" of Trajann) fire Guardian spears at the Meganobz; at the staged hit pause the dock status line reads 'Re-rolled: 1→N', the re-rolled die chip shows its re-rolled face locked with '↻' (a dice can't be re-rolled twice, so it is not offered for Command Re-roll), and the game log Hit row ends '(re-rolled 1→N)'. Before this, both surfaces showed the ORIGINAL 1 as a red die, so an applied re-roll looked like it never happened. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; P1 3 CP, P2 0 CP; Meganobz wounds inflated.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
SettingsService.shooting_pause_policy = "every_step"
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 3
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_MEGANOBZ_A"].models:
	m["wounds"] = 99
	m["current_wounds"] = 99
return true
steps.comment: setup privilege: auto wound allocation; P1 3 CP (so the Command Re-roll chips render), P2 0 CP; Meganobz wounds inflated (see description); pause policy 'every step' (the player's setting in the screenshot)
the Custodian Guard are within 6" of Trajann
select the shooter via the phase action (token-click selection is not under test and hit a neighbouring token on one CI runner)
decline P1's windows here (not under test)
decline only the opponent's (P2) reactive windows here (not under test)
this seed rolls at least one 1, which Captain-General re-rolls
the dock status line names the automatic re-roll
the re-rolled die chip shows its re-rolled face, locked (can't be re-rolled twice)
chips show the re-rolled value, not the original 1
the game log's Hit row lists the re-roll
the dice tray labels the re-rolls and settles those dice on their re-rolled face
